subject: Greenleaf Biotech: Ariba registration blocked by MSA redline + tax ID mismatch
messages:
From: Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@greenleafbio.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenleafbio.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ariba registration failing — MSA redline + tax ID mismatch

Hi Chloe,

We're trying to finish vendor registration in Ariba but the portal keeps rejecting our company because the tax ID format doesn't match your PO ingestion schema and your legal team flagged our MSA redline (indemnity language). Procurement is asking for a clear path to get Greenleaf enrolled this week — our quarter close is next Friday.

I attached the signed signature page we returned and a sample PO that they plan to send. Can someone confirm the exact tax ID format you need (EIN vs. Tax Number) and whether Redwood will accept a narrow addendum on PO acknowledgement while we finish legal?

Thanks,
Sara Wilson
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greenleaf Biotech
(sara.wilson@greenleafbio.com)

Attachments: Greenleaf_SignaturePage.pdf, Greenleaf_PO_sample.xml

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@greenleafbio.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration failing — MSA redline + tax ID mismatch

Sara — thanks for the heads up and the sample PO. Looping in Legal (Kimberly) and Onboarding (Rafael) to triage. Quick answers up front:

- Tax ID: our Ariba connector expects a US EIN (9 digits, no dashes) in the "Tax ID" field. Rafael — can you confirm if we can accept a dash-separated format and normalize on ingest?
- Workaround: We can enable a temporary PO-routing rule to send invoices to billing@redwood.ai and accept POs while legal finalizes the MSA addendum, but Legal must sign off on risk terms first.

I've attached our basic vendor KYC we use for portals. Please fill the W9 and insurance cert and upload to the portal. Kimberly — see Sara's redline note below; can you summarize the must-fix clauses and an acceptable interim document?

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Legal triage + list of non-starters (today)
2) Rafael to confirm Ariba field mapping options and enable PO routing (tomorrow)
3) Test PO from Greenleaf (24–48 hrs after mapping)
4) DocuSign addendum (if needed) and final MSA sign (by end of week if possible)

Sara — if that timeline works, we'll create a short mutual action plan and a JIRA ticket for field mapping.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
(chloe.martin@redwood.ai)

Attachments: Vendor_KYC_Form.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, sara.wilson@greenleafbio.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration failing — MSA redline + tax ID mismatch

Sara / team — I reviewed the redlines. High-level summary:

1) Indemnity & third-party claims — Greenleaf's version expands Redwood's indemnity significantly. We can accept a narrowed carveout limited to direct damages and claims arising from Greenleaf's gross negligence, but cannot accept broad third-party indemnity tied to downstream uses of the model.
2) Data retention & audit rights — we require an audit clause that aligns with our SOC2 retention policy; unlimited audit rights are a non-starter.
3) PO acknowledgement & acceptance window — their proposed 10-day auto-accept conflicts with our standard 3-day acknowledgement SLA. For portal onboarding we could accept a documented "ack_by_window=5" temporary field mapping if Procurement explicitly agrees in writing.
4) Liability cap — propose mutual cap equal to fees paid in previous 12 months (standard).

If Greenleaf agrees to the above bullets as an interim compromise, Legal will prepare an addendum limited to (a) PO acknowledgement window, (b) interim indemnity language, and (c) retention/audit carveouts. That addendum will be DocuSigned and can be attached to their Ariba vendor record to allow registration to proceed.

Please provide: W9 (EIN numeric format), proof of insurance, and the exact XML sample used by Greenleaf for POs so Rafael can map fields.

I attached a highlight PDF of the redlines for reference.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
(kimberly.park@redwood.ai)

Attachments: MSA_redline_highlight.pdf

From: Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@greenleafbio.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenleafbio.com, ariba-support@ariba.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration failing — MSA redline + tax ID mismatch

Thanks Kimberly / Chloe.

We can accept the interim indemnity narrow carve and the 5-day ack_by_window for onboarding only — procurement will record it in our system as an exception. Our IT has attached the PO XML schema we push to suppliers (see attached).

Calendar note: our onboarding team has a hard deadline of 2026-12-20 to have vendors enabled for our Q4 purchases. Ariba Support (included) — can you confirm whether an "ack_by_window" field can be mapped in our tenant and whether XML with EIN in format "12-3456789" will be accepted or needs normalization? Case number AC-987654.

Sara

Attachments: Greenleaf_PO_sample.xml

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: ariba-support@ariba.com, chloe.martin@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, sara.wilson@greenleafbio.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration failing — MSA redline + tax ID mismatch

Hi all — technical update and proposed onboarding sprint:

1) EIN normalization: our connector can accept EINs with dashes but the ingestion routine strips non-numeric characters before matching. I will add a validation rule that accepts both "123456789" and "12-3456789". We can deploy this change to staging today and to production tomorrow morning (low-risk).
2) ack_by_window: Ariba supports custom fields. If Greenleaf's tenant exposes "ack_by_window", we can map it to our PO acknowledgement workflow and set a temporary value of 5 for onboarding. Rafael to coordinate mapping with Ariba tenant admin (ariba-support).
3) Test plan: Rafael to enable mapping in staging, Greenleaf sends a test PO (XML), we validate end-to-end (2–4 hours), then promote mapping to prod.

I created an onboarding ticket ONB-721 and included a small field map CSV for reference. Please confirm a test window (we're available Thu/Fri morning PST).

Rafael Mendes
Senior Systems Engineer, Onboarding
Redwood Inference
(rafael.mendes@redwood.ai)

Attachments: ariba_field_map.csv

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: sara.wilson@greenleafbio.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, procurement@greenleafbio.com
Date: Thu, 18 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration failing — MSA redline + tax ID mismatch

Sara — thanks everyone for the quick responses. Consolidating into a short mutual action plan so we have clear ownership and dates:

Mutual action plan (summary):
- Today (12/18): Greenleaf uploads W9 (EIN numeric) + proof of insurance to portal.
- 12/18 EOD: Kimberly to send DocuSign addendum covering indemnity narrow carve, 5-day ack_by_window for onboarding, and retention carveouts. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/Start?token=0a1b2c3d4e
- 12/19 AM: Rafael deploys EIN normalization rule to staging and maps ack_by_window field with Ariba tenant admin. Test window Thu/Fri morning PST (12/19–12/20). JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-721
- 12/20 EOD: If test results good and addendum signed, Rafael promotes mapping to prod and Legal confirms vendor record is cleared for enrollment.

If we miss the 12/20 window, we'll escalate to Commercial (Marissa Cole) for a one-off purchase exception to avoid Greenleaf missing Q4 buys.

Sara — please confirm you and procurement agree to the dates and upload the documents. Once signed I'll mark the Ariba record and Rafael will run the test.

Appreciate the fast coordination — we should be able to get this across the line with the steps above.

Best,
Chloe Martin

Redwood Inference
